worst_flaw: The design rewards logging fidelity, not correct hand hygiene. Its only compliance guardrail is a 5-point drop that triggers a pause, so logging could improve while hygiene quality slides below that threshold. It also has weak event-history, versioning and appeal staffing, and its three-ward stepped design uses only about 20 assessable actions per ward, which cannot separate the incentive effect from noise or month-to-month case mix.
